rationales.rules-based-checks-v3: VIBE4M incorporates automated linting and static code analysis using coded rules for deprecated APIs, excessive complexity, naming deviations, structural complexity, and known security vulnerabilities to validate the quality and maintainability of AI-generated code.

flags.issue: TESTS: unit, integration, system, and regression tests, including test-driven development; AUTHOR: unclear — VIBE4M prescribes these tests for validating AI-generated code but does not specify who authors them.
